reviews.author: monica venugopal
reviews.text:
We are grateful to share that our fertility journey has been successful and it truly feels like a miracle made possible by Dr. Aiswarya team at Accumed Specialty Clinic... I have consulted multiple doctors before coming to ASCAS and it's Dr. Aiswarya who diagnosed the problem and took our fertility treatment in the prefect direction which helped us to achieve our dream of getting a Baby. I only mantra she said is stay with me, I ensure to get your dream come true.. Many thanks to Dr. Aiswarya...

She always handles patients with her smile and very kind attitude. Also the hygiene of the clinic is good...

A special thanks to the wonderful sisters Anu, Sharmi and Ashwini – since these people are always kind and supportive. Whether it was a small query or a nervous moment, you were always there with a smile and a comforting word. These three always ensures that patients are clear with the instructions given from the Doctor... Down to earth people...

This success is not just ours – it belongs to ASCAS Team. Thank you for making our dream come true.

Keep Rocking Team ASCAS😊

reviews.author: vinoth kumar
reviews.text:
Dr. Aishwarya Parthasarathy
We want to express our deepest gratitude for the exceptional care you provided during the delivery of our baby. From the very first appointment to the moment we held our child in our arms, your calm demeanor, confidence, and warmth made us feel safe and supported throughout the entire journey.

Your professionalism and compassion during labor and delivery were truly remarkable. You took the time to explain every step, answered our questions patiently, and made sure both mother and baby were comfortable and healthy at all times.

We couldn’t have asked for a better doctor to guide us through one of the most important moments of our lives. Thank you for being there with such dedication and kindness.

Finally we felt யாமிருக்க ( Dr. Aishwarya ) பயமேன் ⚜️🙏
